GOLD COAST / COMMERCIAL SERVICES

Fit-outs & make-good

We turn a commercial fit-out or make-good brief into an itemised scope. We review existing finishes, tenancy requirements and access, then coordinate strip-out, repairs and reinstatement as agreed. We separate retained elements from removals so your manager can review the work before it starts.

What we can look after

  • Office and retail alterations, partitions and interior repairs.
  • Painting, finishes and agreed tenancy reinstatement.
  • Strip-out coordination and make-good defect lists.

Planning the work

  1. We review the brief, lease-related scope and existing condition records.
  2. We confirm finishes, access, staging and waste arrangements.
  3. We check the agreed items with your nominated representative and record completion.

Questions about this service

Can you quote from a landlord's make-good list?+

Yes. We review the list alongside site conditions and available plans or photos, clarify ambiguous items and produce an itemised scope. Any change to the agreed work is confirmed before it is carried out.
